races.paceDynamic: Travis, Filey Beach and Langholm will ensure a genuine gallop from the start, with Travis the most reliable front-runner despite his poor win rate. The trio will stretch this 14-runner field early, creating a searching test of stamina that should expose any weak travellers. With multiple confirmed pace-setters guaranteed to go forward, the race will develop into a stamina examination where those who can quicken off the strong pace will benefit. This tactical setup clearly favours hold-up horses who can finish strongly and prominent racers with proven stamina.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Strong Pace Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If Travis and Filey Beach duel early and weaken significantly in the final furlong
scenarios.body: The genuine gallop will set up perfectly for closers who can time their challenge late when the leaders tire. Hold-up specialists with finishing kicks will capitalise on the pace collapse.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Pace Sustains Throughout
scenarios.trigger: If Travis maintains his strong gallop without folding and the race becomes a pure stamina test
scenarios.body: The relentless tempo will favour horses with proven staying power who can grind out the finish. Those with 7f+ experience and stamina will prevail over pure speed horses.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Tactical Slow Start
scenarios.trigger: If the three front-runners are restrained early creating a muddling pace
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint finish where horses with tactical speed benefit most. Prominent racers who can quicken sharply will have the advantage.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Front Runner Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Travis gets an uncontested lead and maintains his rhythm throughout
scenarios.body: The lack of early pressure allows the leader to control the race completely. Travis's front-running style becomes unbeatable with a clear advantage.

watchPoints.text: Travis could get an uncontested lead if Filey Beach and Langholm are restrained early, making him very difficult to peg back
Mount Ruapehu stepping up to 7f after three 6f wins, but his narrow defeat over 5f suggests stamina questions remain
Coconut Bay running just 6 days after Ayr third could be vulnerable to a quick turnaround penalty
Carlton And Co returning after 146-day absence from yard with poor recent strike rate may need the outing
Asian Journey has shown consistent placings but his 15-race maiden tag suggests an inability to get his head in front when it matters

races.paceDynamic: Big Shot Veto appears the sole natural front-runner and will dictate terms unchallenged through comfortable fractions. The prominent horses Highland Shah, Lightening Lad, Sandy Craic, Zarvali and Different Opinions will settle just behind in a cluster, while hold-up horses Pacific Glory and Vega Storm track from the rear. With no pace pressure on Big Shot Veto, this sets up perfectly for the leader to kick clear, though the race shape also favours prominent racers who can quicken from close range. The lack of early pace heavily disadvantages hold-up horses who need a stronger gallop to close into.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Leader Gets Away
scenarios.trigger: If Big Shot Veto establishes an uncontested lead and maintains stamina
scenarios.body: The unchallenged front-runner controls the tempo and kicks clear when the field comes under pressure, with any dangers needing to come from prominent positions. This suits horses who can lead or press the pace throughout.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Pounce
scenarios.trigger: If the clustered prominent group can reel in Big Shot Veto in the final furlong
scenarios.body: Highland Shah, Sandy Craic or Zarvali use their tactical positions to strike late as the leader tires from his solo effort. The pace becomes just strong enough to set up horses tracking closely.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Surprise
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses completely and becomes a sprint finish
scenarios.body: Pacific Glory or Vega Storm benefit from a crawling gallop that becomes a dash from the back, though they need everything to fall right. The step up to 7f could aid their finishing kicks.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Duel Emerges
scenarios.trigger: If Highland Shah or Sandy Craic challenge Big Shot Veto early
scenarios.body: An unexpected pace battle weakens the front-runners and opens the door for horses like Lightening Lad or Zarvali tracking just behind. The increased gallop helps closers but hurts the dueling leaders.

watchPoints.text: Big Shot Veto breaks smartly and establishes clear early lead without challenge from prominent horses
Sandy Craic or Highland Shah move up aggressively to pressure Big Shot Veto in first half-mile
Pacific Glory and other hold-up horses get badly outpaced if fractions become pedestrian early
Vega Storm and Different Opinions show early tactical speed to avoid getting too far back
Lightening Lad jumps cleanly from stalls after previous slow start mentioned in debut

races.paceDynamic: Zimmerman is the only confirmed front runner and will dictate terms from the start, likely setting a steady pace without significant pressure in the early stages. The majority of runners adopt hold-up tactics (Bouboule, Wasthatok, Stellarmasterpiece, Stand Strong, Himself, Arctic Fox) with only Laravie showing prominent tendencies to sit closer. This pace setup creates a pedestrian gallop that will turn into a cavalry charge in the final 3-4 furlongs as the hold-up brigade make their moves. The tactical verdict strongly favours hold-up horses with a strong finishing kick, as they'll get the perfect setup to unleash late runs.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-up horses dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Zimmerman sets an uncontested lead and the pace stays moderate
scenarios.body: The large pack of hold-up runners get ideal conditions to unleash finishing kicks in the straight. Horses with proven stamina over similar distances benefit most from this patient ride scenario.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Pace quickens mid-race
scenarios.trigger: If Laravie or another prominent runner decides to challenge Zimmerman before the turn
scenarios.body: The increased tempo stretches the field and favours horses with tactical speed who can position closer. Late closers struggle to make up the extra ground created by the stronger pace.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Zimmerman kicks clear
scenarios.trigger: If the front runner gets an easy lead and maintains a strong gallop throughout
scenarios.body: The lack of early pressure allows Zimmerman to control the race on his terms and potentially stay clear. Hold-up horses face a tougher task catching a horse who's had everything his own way.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Tactical crawl sprint
scenarios.trigger: If no horse wants to challenge Zimmerman early and the pace becomes extremely slow
scenarios.body: The race becomes a pure sprint finish where class and current form matter most. Horses returning from breaks or showing recent poor form struggle in these circumstances.

watchPoints.text: Zimmerman's early fractions will determine the entire race shape - if he goes too slow the finish becomes chaotic
Stand Strong's 214-day absence makes his fitness level completely unknown despite trainer winning this last year
Laravie is the only horse likely to sit close to Zimmerman and could be the key tactical player
Himself's 0-12 turf record suggests the surface change from his AW wins could be problematic
Arctic Fox's recent course second over 1m6f indicates the step back up in trip should suit

races.paceDynamic: Soul Seeker will take them along from the start with Irish Dancer and Golden Prosperity tracking close behind, creating a solid but sustainable tempo over this sharp 5f. With only one confirmed front-runner and several prominent racers willing to sit handy, the pace should be honest but not frantic in the early stages. The lack of pace pressure means those with finishing kicks get their chance, while the strong tempo ensures stamina over speed becomes crucial. This race shape clearly favours hold-up horses who can produce late surges, as the sustained gallop will stretch the field and create gaps for closers.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Surge
scenarios.trigger: If the pace stays honest and Soul Seeker maintains a steady tempo without being challenged early
scenarios.body: The sustained gallop will string out the field and create space for the back-markers to unleash finishing kicks in the final furlong. Late-running types with proven finishing speed will benefit most from this tactical setup.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Victory
scenarios.trigger: If Irish Dancer or Golden Prosperity can track the pace perfectly and kick clear when Soul Seeker begins to tire
scenarios.body: The handy racers will have the perfect position to strike as they enter the final two furlongs with momentum already built. Their tactical positioning allows them to capitalize without needing an explosive turn of foot.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front Runner Stays On
scenarios.trigger: If Soul Seeker finds improved form at his basement mark and gets an easy lead without pressure
scenarios.body: The 9-year-old could steal a march on the field and prove hard to catch despite his recent struggles. His early advantage combined with the good ground could see him maintain his position to the line.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If Soul Seeker goes too slow early and the race becomes a sprint from the 2f pole
scenarios.body: The lack of early tempo creates a bunched field turning for home, leading to traffic problems and a lottery finish. This tactical mess could throw up any winner depending on racing room and luck in running.

watchPoints.text: Soul Seeker could steal this if backed heavily, as front-runners at basement marks can surprise despite poor recent form
Watch the betting on Monticristo Boy and Lady Bouquet, as both return from long breaks and need market confidence
Irish Dancer's 3lb claiming allowance gives him a significant weight advantage in a tight handicap
Aurora's Doublesix showed promise in blinkers last time and could outrun odds if getting a clear run late
The good ground suits most runners here, eliminating going concerns as a major tactical factor

races.name: Every Race Live On Racing TV Handicap

runners_data.name: Desert Quest
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner who's well-treated on 2024 form and suited by this likely strong pace over 1m4f
runners_data.comment: 8yo who is not easy to fancy on the evidence of this year's two runs
runners_data.spotlight: Well treated on his 2024 exploits and, having returned from a long absence in February, it's possible he's working his way back into form; however, this 8yo is not easy to fancy on the evidence of this year's two runs.

runners_data.name: Rock Armour
runners_data.note: Stays well and showed good form over course and distance last time, hold-up style suits the race shape
runners_data.comment: Close 3rd over C&D last month then didn't see out 1m6f here; each-way claims back at 1m4f
runners_data.spotlight: Just one win from his 25 starts but he was a good third over C&D last month and didn't see out 1m6f when fifth to Free Pic here last time; each-way claims back down in trip.

runners_data.name: Free Pic
runners_data.note: In winning form with prominent style, though the bunching of similar runners could cause traffic issues
runners_data.comment: Two wins here last month and this thriving mare has strong claims
runners_data.spotlight: Won over C&D (good) last month when back on turf and back down in trip and she followed up over 1m6f here; clearly thriving and has strong claims.

runners_data.name: Prince Hector
runners_data.note: Prominent runner returning to turf after 62 days, cheekpieces back on but faces pace congestion
runners_data.comment: The returning cheekpieces may well be a positive and he could be involved
runners_data.spotlight: Kept to AW in the main nowadays and winless since last March; however, he ran well last August when he last tackled turf and the return of cheekpieces (replacing blinkers) may well be in his favour; also has a first-time tongue-tie; could be involved.

runners_data.name: Tracker Issue
runners_data.note: Prominent type off career-low mark after 109-day break, needs to prove sharpness
runners_data.comment: One to watch in the betting following a break but tailed off on AW on last two outings
runners_data.spotlight: On a career-low mark and he's one to watch in the betting following a break; went close when 11-2 at Newcastle (1m4f, AW) last November but it's disconcerting he was tailed off there on his next two outings.

runners_data.name: The Pug
runners_data.note: Inconsistent prominent runner with blinkers on, could benefit if pace collapses ahead
runners_data.comment: A couple of respectable runs this year but he's inconsistent & others are more compelling
runners_data.spotlight: He's posted a couple of respectable fourth placings on AW in 2026 but is inconsistent and has won just once since 2023; others are more compelling.

runners_data.name: Sassy Glory
runners_data.note: Front-runner who must overcome poor recent form and tendency to find little when headed
runners_data.comment: AW winner last September but poor strike-rate and has to improve upon this year's form
runners_data.spotlight: Won at Newcastle (1m, AW) last September and she's been effective over this far and on turf in the past; however, she's won just one of her 28 races and has to improve upon this year's form (1m-1m2f).

runners_data.name: Inspiring Speeches
runners_data.note: Lead runner who was tailed off here last time but has won over course and distance before
runners_data.comment: C&D winner who may have needed his comeback run at Beverley and is not ruled out
runners_data.spotlight: Won at Beverley (1m2f, soft) last July and followed up over this C&D (good); tailed off here next time and down the field on last month's comeback at Beverley, but he may have needed that latest run; not ruled out.

runners_data.name: Muhib
runners_data.note: Hold-up maiden who's been running well lately, the strong pace should suit his closing style
runners_data.comment: Remains a maiden after 21 races but running pretty well of late; might have each-way shout
runners_data.spotlight: Remains a maiden after 21 starts and he's had several opportunities off a similar mark to today's, but he's been running pretty well of late and was third of seven at Beverley last Monday; might have an each-way shout.

runners_data.name: Falaise Blanc
runners_data.note: Prominent type who's been well beaten in three recent starts and needs major improvement
runners_data.comment: Won off this mark on AW last August but soundly beaten on his three outings this spring
runners_data.spotlight: Sole win from 19 attempts came off this mark at Newcastle (1m2f, AW) last August and he's also effective on turf; however, he's been soundly beaten on his three outings this spring.

runners_data.name: Lawmans Blis
runners_data.note: Veteran prominent runner making stable debut, poor recent form is a concern
runners_data.comment: Soundly beaten on recent stable debut on AW but interesting to see if his backers return
runners_data.spotlight: Five-time Flat winner who landed a novice hurdle last March; it's been slim pickings in the main since and he was soundly beaten on his recent stable debut at Southwell; however, he was sent off the 4-1 joint-favourite and it will be interesting to see if his backers return.

runners_data.name: Stitching Wheel
runners_data.note: Hold-up type who hasn't shown much in two runs this season, needs to step forward significantly
runners_data.comment: Displayed early promise in France but unable to make an impact on her two runs this spring
runners_data.spotlight: Displayed early promise in France but unable to make an impact on her two runs this spring and she needs to raise her game.

runners_data.name: Lady Buttercup
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner moving up in trip off low mark, Hollie Doyle booking catches the eye
runners_data.comment: Bumper winner who goes up in trip off lowly opening Flat mark; Hollie Doyle booked
runners_data.spotlight: 0-7 over hurdles and hasn't threatened on her first three Flat starts; however, this bumper winner goes up in trip off a lowly opening Flat mark and Hollie Doyle has been booked; no surprise to see a good run.

runners_data.name: Raysham
runners_data.note: Hold-up type who was always behind last time but could be sharper for the run
runners_data.comment: The return to 1m4f could be a positive on his second start of the season
runners_data.spotlight: Made it 0-8 when always behind on last month's reappearance at Nottingham (1m, good); however, he could be sharper for that run and he twice kept on for third over 1m2f last autumn (good to soft), shaping each time as though 1m4f would be well worth another go; possible player.

races.paceDynamic: Inspiring Speeches and Sassy Glory will duel for the early lead, with Free Pic, Prince Hector, Tracker Issue, The Pug, Falaise Blanc and Lawmans Blis all wanting prominent positions behind them. This creates a wall of pace through the first half-mile, likely producing an honest gallop that will stretch the field. The prominent congestion of 6 runners fighting for position will create traffic problems turning for home, potentially shuffling the pack. This pace scenario strongly favours the hold-up horses who can stay wide and avoid trouble - Desert Quest, Rock Armour, Muhib, Stitching Wheel, Lady Buttercup and Raysham all benefit from this tactical setup.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Contested Pace Suits Closers
scenarios.trigger: If Inspiring Speeches and Sassy Glory go at it early with the prominent brigade bunching behind them.
scenarios.body: The honest pace will find out the weaker front-runners while the hold-up horses get ideal conditions to unleash late runs. Desert Quest, Rock Armour and Muhib can all benefit from the expected strong gallop over this staying trip.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Free Pic Dominates From Prominent
scenarios.trigger: If Free Pic settles just behind the leaders and avoids the early burn-up between the two front-runners.
scenarios.body: Her current winning form and tactical speed allow her to strike turning for home before the closers get organized. The prominent position gives her first run on any that fade from in front.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Favours Speed
scenarios.trigger: If both Inspiring Speeches and Sassy Glory compromise each other in a fierce early battle.
scenarios.body: The pace falls apart completely leaving the race at the mercy of whatever survives from the front or can quicken from midfield. The Pug or Falaise Blanc could inherit if they avoid the early carnage.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Muddling Pace Helps Front
scenarios.trigger: If the two designated leaders are surprisingly restrained and the prominent brigade fails to commit.
scenarios.body: A tactical affair develops that doesn't play to the strengths of the hold-up horses who need a strong gallop. Inspiring Speeches or Sassy Glory could steal it if allowed a soft lead.

watchPoints.text: Watch for early scrimmaging between Inspiring Speeches and Sassy Glory setting up a fierce early pace
Monitor the prominent bunch of Free Pic, Prince Hector, Tracker Issue, The Pug, Falaise Blanc and Lawmans Blis for traffic problems approaching the turn
Track Desert Quest and Rock Armour for market support given their hold-up styles suit the likely race shape
Note if Lady Buttercup shows early pace despite her hold-up style, suggesting connections fancy the trip rise
Watch for any non-runner among the front-runners as this would significantly alter the pace dynamics

races.name: Racing Again 21st May Fillies' Handicap

runners_data.name: North West Gal
runners_data.note: Prominent runner returning to 6f after 5f success, 166 days off but trainer 1/11 in last 14 days suggests ready
runners_data.comment: Found plenty to win 5f maiden on Newcastle AW in November; likely to stay 6f; h'cap debut
runners_data.spotlight: Dropped to 5f after making her debut over 6f but she found plenty when winning a Newcastle AW maiden in November; the return to this trip on her handicap debut, having earlier shown she acts on this track, seems likely to suit if ready to do herself justice.

runners_data.name: Lily Pearl
runners_data.note: Prominent type who thrives on stamina tests, long absence of 228 days but has course form and won last handicap start
runners_data.comment: All 4 runs at 6f, stayed on to win handicap debut at Pontefract in September; off since
runners_data.spotlight: All four runs at 6f on tracks with a stiff finish and she looked well suited by the stamina test when successful on handicap debut at Pontefract (good to soft; has handled good to firm) in September; raised 3lb and off since but should do better as a 3yo.

runners_data.name: Betties Bay
runners_data.note: On a hat-trick from AW, prominent runner who doesn't need much urging but faces turf return after 101 days
runners_data.comment: Missed 2025; made hay on AW (6f) for new yard off much-reduced mark; still well treated
runners_data.spotlight: Turf winner as 2yo; missed all of 2025 but she's made hay off a much-reduced mark on AW for new yard, not needing much urging to complete the 6f hat-trick at Southwell in January; up 4lb but her best handicap form for previous yard was gained off a higher mark than today's; much respected.

runners_data.name: Miss Rainbow
runners_data.note: Prominent runner back on last winning mark with solid course form, often takes keen hold which could suit sustained pace
runners_data.comment: On latest winning mark; often leads so needs things to fall right from widest draw
runners_data.spotlight: Four wins at 5f-7f in 2025, including here; back on her latest winning mark and she ran well over C&D two starts ago so can't be ruled out, albeit she often leads so will need things to fall right from this draw.

runners_data.name: Surprised
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse who needs the run to come to him, 18 days since disappointing effort but has shown ability over 7f here
runners_data.comment: Won Beverley novice (about 7f) as 2yo; well held in handicaps, including for new yard
runners_data.spotlight: Won Beverley novice (about 7f) as a 2yo and ran well over 7f on this track subsequently; well held in all three handicaps, though, including on yard debut back at Beverley 18 days ago; trip query dropped to 6f and might need another run or two.

runners_data.name: Arctic Summer
runners_data.note: Hold-up type struggling with high weights, 18 days since last run and needs significant pace collapse to feature
runners_data.comment: 2yo winner in France; high in weights since trained in Britain and well held this year
runners_data.spotlight: A 2yo winner over 6f (very soft) in France but she's been high in the weights since trained in Britain and little sign of that changing in two runs this year; down another 2lb but likely that it isn't enough.

runners_data.name: Homestrait
runners_data.note: Only front runner who can dictate terms, returning from AW to turf after 26 days with trainer struggling for winners
runners_data.comment: Busy 2yo whose two wins came over 7f, in a maiden and a seller; vulnerable in handicaps
runners_data.spotlight: Busy 2yo whose two wins came over 7f, in a maiden and a seller; creditable show from the front on Southwell AW when reappearing but down the field there since and looks vulnerable off her current mark.

runners_data.name: Pull The Rug
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse returning after 206 days off, pulled hard when last seen which suggests freshness but needs settling
runners_data.comment: Improved to win at Leicester (6f) as 2yo; pulled hard and faded on AW in October
runners_data.spotlight: Improved form when returned to 6f at Leicester (good to soft) in September, but, up 6lb, was soon pulling hard on Newcastle AW next time and paid the price; might be aiming for more cover this time and too soon to write off now back on turf.

races.paceDynamic: Homestrait is the only confirmed front runner in this field and should get an uncontested lead, setting a manageable pace over this sharp 6f. The prominent runners North West Gal, Lily Pearl, Betties Bay and Miss Rainbow will settle just behind but none are aggressive early types who will pressure the leader. This tactical setup creates a race where the tempo builds gradually, allowing those with stamina to finish strongly. The lack of early pace pressure clearly favours hold-up horses and strong finishers who can benefit from the sustainable gallop.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Prevail
scenarios.trigger: If Homestrait sets an uncontested lead allowing the pace to build gradually
scenarios.body: The lack of early pressure creates perfect conditions for the closers to unleash their finishing kicks. Surprised and Arctic Summer get ideal racing room to mount late challenges from their patient positions.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Runners Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent group successfully tracks the steady pace and kicks clear
scenarios.body: North West Gal and Lily Pearl travel easily behind Homestrait before moving smoothly into contention. Their tactical positioning allows them to strike at the optimal moment without facing interference.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front Runner Stays
scenarios.trigger: If Homestrait's uncontested lead proves decisive and the closers leave their run too late
scenarios.body: The combination of soft ground and lack of early pressure allows Homestrait to maintain momentum to the line. The hold-up horses find the sustained gallop has taken the sting out of their usual finishing kick.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Completely
scenarios.trigger: If Homestrait goes too slowly and the field bunches entering the final furlong
scenarios.body: A crawling pace creates a messy sprint finish where positioning becomes crucial. The most reliable recent performers with tactical speed get first run on their rivals.

watchPoints.text: Homestrait must be watched for any signs of over-racing early as the lone leader could set fractions too fast for his own good
North West Gal and Lily Pearl both return from long absences so watch for any signs of ring rustiness in the preliminaries
Miss Rainbow often takes a keen hold so watch if she settles properly behind the steady pace or wastes energy pulling
Arctic Summer and Pull The Rug both need luck in running from their hold-up positions so watch for clear passages in the straight
Betties Bay transitions from all-weather to turf so watch her action and adaptation to the surface change
